annotations.title: Production XML-Structured System Prompt & Guardrail Compiler

description: Compiles a raw task description into a structured XML system prompt (<role>, <context>, <objective>, <constraints>, <workflow>, <output_format>) engineered to prevent instruction drift. Use when authoring or upgrading a system prompt for an autonomous agent or sub-agent workflow; for mapping a task objective to a concrete sequence of MCP tool calls, use route_mcp_workflow_plan instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'task' ('prompt_style' defaults to 'anthropic_xml_tags'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt_style.description: Structural formatting template; defaults to 'anthropic_xml_tags' when omitted.

task.description: Raw task instructions, persona goal, and operational constraints to compile.

name: compile_xml_agent_prompt

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated BPE token length of the compiled prompt.

key_enhancements.description: Specific guardrails and output contract rules injected.

optimization_score.description: Prompt clarity and constraint-completeness score from 0 to 100.
